summary: Backend-only regression + new-edge-case testing for the my-termux agent brain (agent.py, tools_agent.py, chat.py). All 99 pre-existing tests still pass; added 31 new edge-case tests in /app/tests/test_agent_edge.py covering parser, safety, tool executor error paths, and chat glue. Final result: 130/130 passing.
critical_code_review_comments: agent.py L189 uses `for hop in range(MAX_HOPS): ... else: final_body = 'max hops...'` — correct use of the for/else construct, but MAX_HOPS is captured at import time via `os.environ.get('MYTERMUX_AGENT_MAX_HOPS', '6')`. Tests correctly monkeypatch the module attribute, but a runtime override via env var won't work after import — minor. Consider reading it inside run_turn if runtime configurability matters.

agent.py L204: `openrouter.chat_stream(messages, on_delta=on_delta)` — only catches RuntimeError. If openrouter raises a different exception type (e.g., httpx.ConnectError, KeyError from bad JSON), the loop would propagate. Consider broadening to `except Exception` with a specific error log, or ensure openrouter wraps everything into RuntimeError.

tools_agent.py L60 `_tool_write_file` — writes even if content is empty string; and the returned message 'backup: {p}.bak if existed' is a literal string that shows curly braces to the model. Cosmetic. Also the .bak path uses `p.with_suffix(p.suffix + '.bak')` in tools.write_file — for path 'y.txt', that produces 'y.txt.bak' which matches the message; for '.bashrc' (no suffix), `.with_suffix('.bak')` will produce '.bak' (unintended). Consider `Path(str(p) + '.bak')` in tools.write_file for robustness.

tools_agent.py L138 _tool_web_search — DuckDuckGo's IA API is rate-limited and sometimes returns HTML on failure; the current code only catches JSON errors via generic Exception. Fine for now but consider logging the raw response body for debugging.

chat.py has no /q help hint after successful command execution; UX-wise good enough. Also, `_plain_reply` records the assistant message but the streamed text is captured only from openrouter's return, not from on_delta — matches agent behaviour, OK.
agent.py `_confirm()` uses input() and catches EOFError. In non-TTY test runs (piped stdin) this returns False which is safe. Good.
seed_data_creation: None — every test uses the `isolated_home` fixture in /app/tests/conftest.py which provisions a fresh MYTERMUX_HOME per test. OpenRouter, Cloudinary, and httpx are all mocked (no real network).
context_for_next_testing_agent: my-termux is a Termux CLI Python package under /app/mytermux/. Do NOT touch /app/backend or /app/frontend (unused scaffolding). Run tests with `python -m pytest tests/ -q` from /app/. The agent brain lives in /app/mytermux/agent.py (parse_response + run_turn), tools in /app/mytermux/tools_agent.py (REGISTRY of 12 tools + is_dangerous), CLI chat glue in /app/mytermux/chat.py. Mock openrouter.chat_stream with monkeypatch (helper: `_mock_openrouter_sequence` in both test_agent.py and test_agent_edge.py). Mock httpx by injecting a fake module into sys.modules (see test_tool_web_search_parses_ddg_json in test_agent.py and test_tool_web_search_httpx_raises in test_agent_edge.py). Cloudinary is mocked via `_install_fake_cloudinary` in test_media_cloud.py. Test totals now: test_mytermux.py=28, test_media_cloud.py=25, test_media_errors.py=13, test_agent.py=33, test_agent_edge.py=31 = 130.
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a verification + edge-case-coverage pass. No production bugs discovered. Every checklist item from the review request was exercised: parser (thoughts, first-tool-only, malformed JSON → _raw_json_error, case-insensitive, empty/whitespace args, unicode, JSON-array-becomes-raw); tool registry (all 12 tools present, describe_tools, unknown-tool error); every executor's happy path and error path (read_file missing/on-dir, write_file first-write no-bak and missing-parent, list_dir missing/not-a-dir, shell missing cmd + happy path, git non-repo + unknown action, add_task/add_goal missing title + happy path, media_list empty, notify skipped, web_search missing query + httpx raises + empty DDG response + parses DDG JSON, finish returns __FINISH__); safety (rm -rf /, rm -rf ~/, /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/, .bashrc, /config.yaml, safe tools always False, unknown tool False); agent loop (single-hop final, tool→observation→final two-hop, dangerous-denied via user_denied_tool_call, dangerous-confirmed actually writes, MAX_HOPS graceful exit, RuntimeError caught to empty return, observation with angle brackets doesn't corrupt next hop, unicode I/O survives, conversation persistence with model tag, final answer without finish tool still accepted); chat (/tools lists 12 tools, /plain calls openrouter once with no agent loop, /agent default invokes run_turn, /help lists all commands, /new bumps session id, /task and /goal shortcuts write to DB, empty input skipped without calling model).
